[EN] (Leander stares intensively at the Spiritstone, while the magic sword he holds emanates dark energy. There isn't the slightest hint of emotion on his face. He seems to be deep in contemplation.)
[ES] (Leander mira fijamente la Spiritstone, mientras la espada mágica que sostiene emana energía oscura. No hay ni el más mínimo rastro de emoción en su rostro. Parece estar profundamente concentrado.)
